basics.name: Dorian Gailhard
basics.label: PhD Student in Artificial Intelligence
basics.summary: PhD student at Télécom Paris. My research focuses on scalable machine learning methods for graph and hypergraph generation, structured combinatorial systems, and applications to Electronic Design Automation (EDA).

work.name: Télécom Paris
work.summary: Advised by Jhony H. Giraldo, Enzo Tartaglione, and Lirida Naviner. Researching scalable generative models for graphs and hypergraphs with applications to Electronic Design Automation. Current work focuses on hierarchical graph generation, particularly diffusion- and flow-matching-based approaches, and reinforcement learning for combinatorial optimization problems arising in EDA.
highlights: Topic: System on Chips Design leveraging Artificial Intelligence

work.name: Università degli Studi di Padova
work.summary: Supervised by Francesco Rinaldi and Damiano Zeffiro. Studied continuous formulations of variants of the Maximum Clique Problem in k-graphs. Investigated Lovász extensions and continuous relaxations for discrete combinatorial optimization problems, deriving theoretical results and developing Python and C++ implementations of the proposed methods.
highlights: Topics: Clustering, Graph Theory, Optimization, Tensor Theory, Python, C++ , Operations Research

education.summary: Research-oriented master’s program in machine learning, artificial intelligence, optimization, computer vision, and applied mathematics.
Engineering-oriented program covering data science, machine learning, statistical learning, cloud computing, and large-scale data processing.
Broad engineering curriculum with a specialization in computer science, covering algorithms, software engineering, mathematics, signal processing, and telecommunications.
Two years intensive program preparing for the French national competitive exams for Grandes Écoles, equivalent to a Bachelor in Maths and Physics.
